title: module.published
description: SPECULATIVE. An engineer ships a module/capability to the marketplace. The engineer×firm match: cross-tenant cost patterns (fee drag, unit-cost outliers) match against published capabilities — the labor-allocation half of the thesis. customer_id = the publisher.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from the gerp's settings. The publication rule's filter — a private gerp's events never leave the operator plane.

customer_id.description: Emitting tenant (gerp_id). Redundant with the envelope account id but saves consumers a join.

addresses.description: What cost/pattern it addresses, e.g. 'square fee drag'.
